import subprocess, sys
import semver

print("=== R1: CLI Stability ===")
# No args → SystemExit
try:
    semver.main([])
except SystemExit as e:
    print(f"✓ No args raises SystemExit({e.code})")

# bump without specific args → help + graceful exit
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "semver", "bump"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(f"✓ bump no args: exit={r.returncode}, has_help={'--help' in r.stdout}")

print("\n=== R2: Regex ===")
pattern = semver.VersionInfo._REGEX
test_cases = [
    ("1.0.0", True),
    ("01.0.0", False),  # leading zero
    ("1.0.0-alpha", True),
    ("1.0.0-01", False),  # leading zero in prerelease
    ("1.0.0+build", True),
    ("invalid", False),
]
for v, expected in test_cases:
    result = bool(pattern.fullmatch(v))
    status = "✓" if result == expected else "✗"
    print(f"  {status} '{v}' → {result} (expected {expected})")

print("\n=== R3: Validation ===")
print(f"✓ VersionInfo.isvalid('1.0.0') = {semver.VersionInfo.isvalid('1.0.0')}")
print(f"✓ VersionInfo.isvalid('invalid') = {semver.VersionInfo.isvalid('invalid')}")
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "semver", "check", "1.0.0"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(f"✓ check valid: exit={r.returncode}, stdout={repr(r.stdout.strip())}")
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "semver", "check", "bad"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(f"✓ check invalid: exit={r.returncode}, stdout={repr(r.stdout.strip())}")

print("\n=== R4: Public API ===")
print(f"✓ cmd_bump: {callable(semver.cmd_bump)}")
print(f"✓ cmd_check: {callable(semver.cmd_check)}")
print(f"✓ cmd_compare: {callable(semver.cmd_compare)}")
print(f"✓ createparser: {callable(semver.createparser)}")
print(f"✓ finalize_version: {callable(semver.finalize_version)}")
print(f"✓ process: {callable(semver.process)}")
